# The Architect boundary

`the-architect` owns cross-project architecture memory, component definitions, component application
results, and architectural engagement history in its dedicated architecture-home repository.

Project Documentation Archivist continues to own durable documentation inside each target project:
README, AGENTS, DECISIONS, RUNBOOK, and catalog traceability. It may consume Architect findings as
evidence, but neither role mirrors the other's database and GitHub Issues/Projects remain operational
work state.
